criteria.requirement: Add Interval.split(points, *, ownership='right') returning an ordered tuple of same-class nonempty atomic intervals. Sort/deduplicate a finite one-shot cut iterable, ignore cuts outside the interior of each atomic part and explicitly assign internal cut points to the right or left partition. Preserve original exterior openness, gaps, empty/singleton intervals and comparable date endpoints. Returned pieces must be pairwise disjoint and their union exactly the input; do not change Interval normalization to keep partitions apart.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
